question: How should the practitioner draw in the vital air at the root of tongue and palate?
premises: The practice is located at the root of tongue and palate
The vital air is to be taken in
The action should be done slowly
inference: Placing attention at the root of tongue and palate, one should slowly drink in the vital air.
plain_english: Placing oneself at the root of the tongue and palate, one should slowly drink in the breath.
